next.reason: 1985 makes USE BEFORE REPORTING available only where the Report Writer module is supported. In 2023 identifier-1 of USE BEFORE REPORTING 'shall reference a report group' (§2023:14.9.49.3 SR9), and report groups, the report section and the report writer statements are an optional language element (§2023:A.4.11 items 3-5, 21-24; §2023:4.2.7: an implementor need not implement them). So USE BEFORE REPORTING still exists only where report writer is supported; a conforming 1985 program means the same. A.4.11 and 4.2.7 carry no catalog id, so 'to' names only SR9.
